pro.en: On 23 May 2004, a diamond valued at $300,000 was affixed to the front of an F1 car at the Monaco Grand Prix; the car crashed on the opening lap, and more than 22 years later the gem has never been recovered. BBC Sport describes it as Formula 1's biggest unsolved mystery.

Jaguar Racing's results were mediocre and its parent company Ford had resolved to withdraw the team from the sport, so the squad sought a publicity coup by teaming up with the film Ocean's Twelve, which was shooting scenes in Monte Carlo. George Clooney, Brad Pitt and Matt Damon took part in the weekend, and communications director Nav Sidhu arranged for diamonds from the firm Steinmetz to be attached to both Jaguar cars.

The stones were fixed to the nose cones of Mark Webber's and Christian Klien's cars. In a chaotic opening lap, Klien clipped one of the Jordan cars and then struck the barriers at the Loews hairpin; he emerged unhurt, but by the time Sidhu reached the wreck after the race, the diamond had vanished.

Theories proliferated: that the stone was fake, that a spectator pocketed it, or that Klien crashed deliberately. Sidhu categorically rejects the notion of a counterfeit, arguing that a diamond company would not risk its reputation, while former team principal Tony Purnell suspects someone pocketed it or that it was swept away. Both maintain a deliberate crash made no sense, as the damage to the car cost more than the diamond.

Ultimately, the missing gem became the story of the weekend. Purnell says nobody mentioned Jarno Trulli winning the race and everybody asked where the diamond was, and he believes the publicity eased the sale of the team to Red Bull six months later. For marketing students, it illustrates how an unplanned twist can draw more attention than scripted promotion.

views.view: Sidhu says a diamond company would not use a fake, and Purnell believes the stone was real and that someone probably picked it up.
Purnell says the missing diamond brought great publicity and he thinks it helped the later sale of the team to Red Bull.

paragraphs.en: Democrat Scott Colom won a close Senate race in Mississippi, and he will become the state's first Black US senator in more than 150 years. He will be only the third Black senator from Mississippi in history. Mississippi is deeply conservative, so the result is historic: the state last sent a Democrat to the Senate in 1982 and had not seated a Black senator since 1875.
paragraphs.ko: 민주당의 스콧 콜럼이 미시시피 상원 선거에서 접전 끝에 이겼고, 150년 넘는 만에 주 최초의 흑인 연방 상원의원이 돼요. 그는 미시시피 역사상 세 번째 흑인 상원의원일 뿐이에요. 이 결과는 1982년 이후 민주당 상원의원을 보내지 않았고 1875년 이후 흑인 상원의원도 앉히지 않은 매우 보수적인 주에서 역사적이에요.

sents.en: Democrat Scott Colom won a close Senate race in Mississippi, and he will become the state's first Black US senator in more than 150 years.
sents.ko: 민주당의 스콧 콜럼이 미시시피 상원 선거에서 접전 끝에 이겼고, 150년 넘는 만에 주 최초의 흑인 연방 상원의원이 돼요.

sents.en: He will be only the third Black senator from Mississippi in history.

paragraphs.en: The first two were Hiram Revels and Blanche Bruce, and both belonged to the Republican Party. Revels was chosen after the Civil War and served for just over a year, from 1870 to 1871, campaigning strongly for racial equality. Blanche Bruce, who had been born into slavery, then became the first Black person to complete a full term in the chamber, serving from 1875 to 1881. Both served before the Jim Crow laws began to force racial segregation across the South.

He said many people across the state's history have raised it up through prayer in very dark times. For college students in the US and abroad, the story shows how voting by young people can shape a close race.

pro.en: Democrat Scott Colom prevailed in a tight Senate contest in Mississippi and will become the state's first Black U.S. senator in more than 150 years, and only the third in its history. The outcome is a landmark in a deeply conservative state that last sent a Democrat to the Senate in 1982 and had not seated a Black senator since 1875.

Colom follows two Republicans, Hiram Revels and Blanche Bruce. Revels, picked after the Civil War as Mississippi's first senator, held the seat for just over a year, from 1870 to 1871, campaigning vigorously for racial equality. Bruce, who was born into slavery, went on to become the first Black person to complete a full term in the chamber, from 1875 to 1881. Both served before the repressive Jim Crow laws began to enforce racial segregation in Mississippi and elsewhere in the South.

Colom's success in mobilizing young people and the state's large Black population, who are expected to have turned out in high numbers, was a significant factor in his victory. The BBC spoke to students at Jackson State University, a historically Black college, before the race was called; many were voting for the first time and had backed Colom, and one 18-year-old said she felt change was what Mississippi needed.

In his victory speech, Colom recalled that Revels, a minister and Civil War chaplain, had built support for his Senate bid through his words, and said that many people through the state's history had raised it up through prayer in very dark times.

issues.title: How the New James Bond Will Be Announced, and What Can Go Wrong
issues.gist: Amazon MGM Studios is getting ready to name the next James Bond. A Guardian look back shows that how the news is shared can matter a lot, and some past announcements went badly.
issues.gistKo: 아마존 MGM 스튜디오가 다음 제임스 본드를 발표할 준비를 하고 있어요. 가디언은 소식을 어떻게 알리느냐가 중요하고 과거에 실수도 있었다고 돌아봐요.

paragraphs.en: Amazon MGM Studios is preparing to announce the next James Bond, though nothing is official yet. It is widely understood that the list of actors to replace Daniel Craig is down to five. They are Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O'Connor, Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult.
paragraphs.ko: 아마존 MGM 스튜디오는 다음 제임스 본드를 발표할 준비를 하고 있지만 아직 공식 발표는 없어요. 다니엘 크레이그를 대신할 배우 후보가 다섯 명으로 좁혀졌다고 널리 알려져 있어요. 칼럼 터너, 잭 로던, 조시 오코너, 로버트 패틴슨, 니컬러스 홀트예요.

Amazon paid over $1bn to gain creative control from Barbara Broccoli and Michael G Wilson. It has hired Steven Knight to write the script and Denis Villeneuve to direct. A new lead actor will send the clearest signal of where the series is heading.

In 1962 the news was small: a 15-line article in the trade magazine Daily Cinema showed Sean Connery with a cigarette. In 2005, Daniel Craig was sent down the Thames on a Royal Marine speedboat before a press conference at HMS President.

paragraphs.en: But things did not go as planned for Craig. Safety rules meant he had to wear a life-jacket, and the media laughed at the picture. Craig later called the day a train wreck and said he was terrified. A publicist said a major leak had forced producers to rush the event. Fans will now wait to see how Amazon reveals its new 007.

sents.ko: 하지만 크레이그에게는 계획대로 되지 않았어요.

sents.en: Safety rules meant he had to wear a life-jacket, and the media laughed at the picture.
sents.ko: 안전 규정 때문에 구명조끼를 입어야 했고 언론은 그 모습을 비웃었어요.

sents.en: Craig later called the day a train wreck and said he was terrified.
sents.ko: 크레이그는 나중에 그날이 엉망이었고 겁에 질렸다고 말했어요.

sents.en: A publicist said a major leak had forced producers to rush the event.
sents.ko: 한 홍보 담당자는 큰 유출 때문에 제작진이 서둘러 행사를 준비했다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Fans will now wait to see how Amazon reveals its new 007.
sents.ko: 팬들은 이제 아마존이 새 007을 어떻게 공개할지 지켜볼 거예요.

pro.en: Amazon MGM Studios is gearing up to reveal the next James Bond, though no decision has been made public. The shortlist of actors to follow Daniel Craig is widely believed to have been cut to five: Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O'Connor, Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult.

The search arrives at an auspicious juncture for a franchise now 25 films deep, which has taken in upwards of $7.8bn at the box office since 1962. Amazon handed over more than $1bn to secure creative control from Barbara Broccoli and Michael G Wilson, then recruited Steven Knight as screenwriter and Denis Villeneuve as director; the choice of lead will be the strongest hint yet of where the series is going.

The Guardian argues that how a casting is made known can alter the actor's life. In 1962 the news was modest, a 15-line notice in the trade magazine Daily Cinema alongside a picture of Sean Connery with a cigarette. By 2005, Craig was whisked along the Thames on a Royal Marine speedboat ahead of a press conference at HMS President.

The plan unravelled in part: under safety rules Craig had to put on a lifejacket, an image the press mocked, and he later called the day a train wreck at which he was terrified. A publicist told the paper that a serious leak had pushed the producers to organise the event in a hurry, and audiences will now be watching how Amazon presents its new 007.

views.view: A new Bond announcement can shape an actor's life, and past launches show how a leak or a small mistake can turn it awkward.

talk.q: Why does the way a big announcement is made matter?
talk.qKo: 큰 발표를 어떻게 하느냐가 왜 중요할까요?
talk.answer: The story shows that a first impression can shape how people see a person. Craig's life-jacket photo was laughed at in the media. I think a good plan and a calm start can help the new person feel safe.
talk.answerKo: 이야기는 첫인상이 사람을 보는 방식을 바꿀 수 있음을 보여 줘요. 크레이그의 구명조끼 사진은 언론의 웃음거리가 되었어요. 좋은 계획과 차분한 시작이 새 사람을 편안하게 해 준다고 생각해요.
